findings.summary: vitest.config.ts:5 does not constrain test discovery. QA confirmed that the canonical run discovers the 24 root suites plus unrelated suites from six nested living-memory worktrees, executing them against the root CLI and failing. Validation cannot reliably certify the active branch while delegated worktrees exist.

src/work/digest.ts:35 and :42 hash Git diff output without normalizing its format. With this machine's diff.mnemonicPrefix=true, workDigest emits c/w prefixes while committedWorkDigest emits a/b for identical content, rejecting authentic review remediation evidence. QA confirmed six failures in remediation, adversarial and repair tests; all 48 targeted tests pass with mnemonicPrefix=false.
